processRoles: E: Root-controlled external entry retains direct W Popen and independently duplicated outer Job handle.
W: separate witness uses admitted default OwnedProcess to contain G/R/C/science in outer Job.
G: accepted OwnedProcess.process startup gate; retained Popen PID differs from R/C.
R: contained parent directly retains C Popen; waits for E Job-handle retention ack before C startup.
C: reused V2 controller owns accepted inner science Job and canonical command.

origin.origin: E original native QPC before W/G/R/C/science startup; all descendants inherit exact origin/frequency.
origin.values: native QPC ticks and frequency as canonical exact decimal integer strings
origin.frequency: checked against native QueryPerformanceFrequency inside prospective actual only

containment: W default OwnedProcess assigns G before R launch; R's direct controller Popen and inner science Job inherit containment. E job-handle retention ack precedes controller startup.
resident: E + W + current outer Job member union once; W/C subsets are partial. Current unknown/overshoot fails closed; sampled and observed historical peaks are qualified.
storage: Fresh outer OWN newregular <=1GiB and COMBINED current outer TMP+controller TMP <=32MiB. Outer live and final guards fail unknown/overshoot. Unsampled high-water unknown.
logs: science child <=240KiB plus shared controller/R/W/E diagnostics <=16KiB, all raw before decode; no silent truncation.

teardown.implementation: Accepted default OwnedProcess.stop only; no windows_job_factory, unowned fallback, replacement kill sequence or product Source modifications.
teardown.retainedWait: R retains/directly waits C Popen; W waits accepted G; E retains/directly waits W plus independent native named member handles.
teardown.jobDrainAndClose: Pass-through audits original active()/close() calls; final cumulative accounting is read before backend closure. Native teardown remains default accepted stop; audited backend returns are not independent Root CloseHandle observation.
teardown.cleanupOnFailures: Attempt bounded stop, retained wait, raw reader join, stdout close when joined, retained original handle close and all readout handle closure; preserve first cause and one shared whole deadline.
teardown.observationVsFailure: Unavailable postexit memory/population observation does not change successful target into failure; earlier live unknown/overshoot and wait/drain/close failures remain first cause.
teardown.remainingOriginalBudget: accepted stop needs its existing six-second budget available; every wait/join/receipt shares external original whole deadline
teardown.rootDuplicate: E duplicates W outer Job handle before controller launch ack; after W retained wait, queries Job/accounting independently then closes only its duplicated handle. Default W stop/drain remains the normal teardown.
teardown.failurePath: Every error requests W default stop; bounded direct W/C retained Popen termination may be necessary on failure, with inherited containment and default Job kill-on-close. No guessed PID, taskkill, replacement job factory or product teardown.

freshRootPhysical: E duplicated outer Job survives original W handle close. After direct retained W wait, E queries that Job and retained named identities; reads saved C/W/R/output metadata/postSTAT. No CI/host wait for E is claimed by E.

binding.rootGrant: Private future grant SHA supplied to E; explicit runtimeProjectionAllowed; E adds original QPC integers in private OWN runtime-grant.
binding.commit: Exact prepared local commit is bound by Root outside public Source before one authorized push; runtime GITHUB_SHA/run/attempt check, no circular commit constant.
binding.noPrivatePublication: Private Root grants, runtime-grant and private proof paths excluded from public Source/publish inventory.

uncertainty: postexit process peak counters when unavailable
independent final outer parent peak/reap until Root fresh physical readout
target role mapping beyond captured native identities
peerCorrections: -I/-S preserved: explicit same-directory absolute importlib specs; no script-directory sys.path insertion.
Outer live and final guards sum outer TMP plus controller TMP; one32MiB declared OWN subset, unknown or overshoot fails closed.
